generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable
The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the date of opening of financial bid
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges as per GoK circular no.24.01.2025 while quoting their rates. The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere (GoKcircularno.07.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate. Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, prevailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills.a)A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment (AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology.b)A penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust.

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection.

The successful bidder shall make payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Government of Karnataka from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful bidder shall furnish Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India within 20 days of receipt of Letter of Intent through e-portal.
Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) shall be equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount and should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period.

Work completion period is 3 months excluding monsoon. Defect liability period (a) For the TPO membrane is 120 months and (b) For all other civil works is 12 months from the date of completion of the work.
If tenderer has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practice, action shall be initiated finance department, Government of Karnataka Notification No.FD884 Exp-12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020.

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Civil) Hosangadi, Kundapura Tq , Udupi District -576282 during office hours. Mobile-9449598843.

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one work involving TPO membrane of value not less than Rs. 7.16 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the Work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking from the officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

Tender capacity - (A x N x 2.5-B), where, A-Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the Completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 0.25 years. B-Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the 0.25years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

itemList.description: Dismantling old plaster or skirting raking out joints and cleaning the surface for plaster including disposal of rubbish to the dumping ground to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Surface preparation: Removing loose particles, previous treatments if any etc, cleaning with wire brush or mechanical mean completely. Opening the cracks if any by making V groove all along the surface/ concrete cracks and coving between the floor and wall joint surface. Cleaning and sealing the same with polymer mortar [1:3] admixed with SBR latex at 1.5kg/5Okg cement, pressure grouting, wherever necessary, providing and applying ready mix polymer mortar by trowel to get neat surface wherever necessary. Completing the work including cost of materials, labour, HOM and transportation etc., with all lead and lifts, complete as per specifications and as directed by the engineer-in-charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing and installing, food grade TPO single side Fleece back membrane, membrane shall be high performance, heat weldable, thermoplastic polyolefin (TPO) sheet, manufactured & supplied in specified thickness of 1.2mm, designed for waterproofing and heat shielding the surface of water tanks, with puncture resistance of 57 LBF- ASTM D 751, breaking Strength 125 LBF- ASTM D751, tear strength 30 LBF - ASTM D 751 procedure B, high peel strength of seam joints and heat welds, Chlorine free, plasticizer free, phthalate free. Environmentally friendly and safe for humans, Exceptional resistance to heat, UV, Ozone, bacteria, chemical, acid corrosion, Resistance to root penetration, suitable for green roofs, Continuous serviceability from -30 degree C to 100 degree C-without cracking, tearing or brittleness failure, 100% recyclable. Shall be applied over the well prepared surface by applying cementitious adhesive for the roof, high performance adhesive over the wall surface and at back side of the Single side TPO membrane, supported with mechanical anchors,lapping of membrane for width of 75mm by hot air welding including grinding sharp edges at the substrate, cleaning the substrate to make them free from all contaminants, pretreating all the pipe penetrations by installing a layer of Single side Fleece membrane: Approved by CFTRI, etc., complete with all lead and lifts including arranging diesel generator for powersupply., Complete as perspecifications etc., and as directed by the engineer-in-charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) to brick/stone masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge up to 3mtr height. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Epoxy bonding of new concrete to old concrete. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Applying epoxy mortar over leached, honey combed and spalled concrete surface and exposed steel reinforcement complete as per Technical Specification. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Demolishing stone rubble masonry in cement mortar manually/ by mechanical means including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer -in- charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing and laying in Cement Concrete M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for all Basement & surface level works, return walls, retaining walls, sunken floors etc. The granite/trap/ basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement shall be paid separately but includes formwork - Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing 200mm DI flanged pipe conforming to IS 8329 : 2000 with latest amendments with Cement Mortar Lining (CML) with Portland Slag Cement as per IS 455:1989 and Metallic Zinc Coating as per annexure A of IS 8329 with finishing layer of Bituminous Coating as per Annexure C of IS 8329 and Flanges: Metallic zinc rich epoxy paint & Bituminous Coating, laying true to line and hoisting in position and aligning to correct plumb including cost of jointing material, conveying to work spot with all lead and lifts etc.,, complete for PN 10.00. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Removing the G.I. pipes, cleaning, washing and using at spot or conveying from workspot to office/store with all lead and lift including removal of all items such as collars, elbows, tees, bends, gland cocks, cuts and threads with appurtenances. Pipes of dia 100mm. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing, Laying and Fixing of GI pipes conforming to IS 1239:1990 with latest amendments complete with GI fittings (excluding the cost of fittings) with cuts and threads wherever necessary, including testing for water tightness, with all lead and commissioning. (contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) For:Heavy Duty GI Pipe etc. complete. Heavy Duty GI pipe of 100mm dia. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Providing & fixing of GI specials of minimum 5.4mm thick such as bends, tail pieces, reduces etc. conforming to IS 1239:1990 with latest amendments and including perfect linking and welding of joints to correct position includng cost and conveyance of materials with all lead and lifts, cost all labour and giving satisfactory hydraulic test as per IS:3589:2001 with latest amendments for test pressure and working pressure both at factory and site etc. complete as per detailed specifications with inside lining two coat of food grade epoxy painting of approved make with Each coat of 250 micron thick (after dry) over one coat of food grade epoxy primer of approved make with minimum of 50 micron thick (after dry) and outside 25mm thick coating in CM 1:3 by providing 50x50mm weld mesh including loading and unloading of the pipes for the following category to suit PSC / MS / CI / AC / DI / PVC pipes. Pipe bends,branches, tail pieces, reducers etc. for upto 500mm dia pipes. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST

Applying one coat of water thinnable cement primer of approved brand and manufacture on wall surface: Water thinnable cement primer to give an even shade after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No.FD417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09.08.2024bidders are required to submit their fnancial quotes excluding GST
